additional_source_evidence.title: All ranks
additional_source_evidence.long_description: Instructional Staff is an occupational category that is comprised of staff who are either: 1) Primarily Instruction or 2) Instruction combined with research and/or public service. The intent of the Instructional Staff category is to include all individuals whose primary occupation includes instruction at the institution. Instruction (only) - Persons whose specific assignments customarily are made for the purpose of providing instruction or teaching. Regardless of title, academic rank, or tenure status, these employees formally spend the majority of their time providing instruction or teaching. Instruction combined with research and/or public service (IRPS) - Persons for whom it is not possible to differentiate between instruction or teaching, research, and public service because each of these functions is an integral component of his/her regular assignment. Regardless, of title, academic rank, or tenure status, these employees formally spend the majority of their time providing instruction, research, and/or public service. Full-time staff (employees) As defined by the institution. The type of appointment at the snapshot date determines whether an employee is full-time or part-time. The employee's term of contract is not considered in making the determination of full- or part-time. A status designated by the institution according to the institution's policies. The IPEDS HR survey includes the ranks of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Instructor, and Lecturer.

answer:
In our local IPEDS data, Yale University reported **3,800 instructional staff with faculty status in Fall 2024**.

| Scope | Full-time | Part-time | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Instructional staff with faculty status | 2,995 | 805 | 3,800 |

This counts instructional staff who also hold faculty status: people primarily teaching, or teaching combined with research or public service. It does not include all staff with faculty status in other occupations, or instructional staff without faculty status.

Counts include medical-school staff where reported. Figures refer to Yale University as the reporting institution, not a separately identified college or school.

Source: local IPEDS Human Resources, Fall 2024, EAP2024; November 1 snapshot; provisional release.
